title: Documented backup
text: **Priority:** MUST Store and cloud business data shall have documented backup procedures appropriate to the deployment.
releaseGate: Cloud-disconnected acceptance suite; no checkout dependency.

title: Multiple recovery points
text: **Priority:** MUST Production backup design shall maintain multiple recovery points and an off-device/off-host copy according to approved retention policy.
releaseGate: Backup/restore-test operational acceptance.

title: Restore testing
text: **Priority:** MUST Backups shall be periodically restored in a controlled test and representative business data verified.
releaseGate: Backup/restore-test operational acceptance.

title: Migration recovery
text: **Priority:** MUST Database/schema migration procedures shall include rollback/recovery strategy and backup compatibility checks.
releaseGate: Backup/restore-test operational acceptance.

title: RPO/RTO ownership
text: **Priority:** MUST Each production deployment shall define approved RPO and RTO targets before go-live; exact values remain an operations decision until approved.
releaseGate: Contract or integration acceptance as applicable.

title: Backup health visibility
text: **Priority:** MUST Failed, stale or missing backups shall be visible to authorized operations/support personnel.
releaseGate: Contract security tests, revocation/fail-closed tests.

title: Post-restore idempotency
text: **Priority:** MUST Recovery and subsequent synchronization/retry shall not duplicate transactions already accepted locally or centrally. ## 9. Observability, support and operability
releaseGate: Backup/restore-test operational acceptance.

title: Exact money
text: **Priority:** MUST Money calculations shall use exact decimal/minor-unit semantics; JavaScript binary floating-point shall not be the authoritative representation of monetary value.
releaseGate: Contract security tests, revocation/fail-closed tests.

title: Quantity precision
text: **Priority:** MUST Quantity precision shall be deterministic for whole, fractional and weighed items according to item/UoM rules.
releaseGate: Contract or integration acceptance as applicable.

title: Atomic local posting
text: **Priority:** MUST Where the FRS defines one local posting transaction, all required local effects shall commit together or roll back together.
releaseGate: Contract or integration acceptance as applicable.

title: Stable identifiers
text: **Priority:** MUST Business documents, payment attempts/commitments, refunds, stock movements, audit events and synchronization messages shall have stable identities sufficient for retry and reconciliation.
releaseGate: Contract or integration acceptance as applicable.

title: Multi-counter consistency
text: **Priority:** MUST Concurrent counters shall not silently overwrite or double-consume protected business state such as held sales, stock-count sessions, customer credit exposure or document numbering.
releaseGate: Contract or integration acceptance as applicable.

title: Historical meaning
text: **Priority:** MUST Later master-data, price, country-rule or configuration changes shall not silently reinterpret posted historical transactions.
releaseGate: Contract or integration acceptance as applicable.

title: Country-rule versioning
text: **Priority:** MUST Posted transactions shall retain sufficient country context/version/effective-rule outcome to preserve historical meaning after country-pack updates. ## 5. Scalability
releaseGate: Contract or integration acceptance as applicable.

title: Store Node service
text: **Priority:** MUST Store Node shall support reliable Windows service operation and restart behavior appropriate to store deployment.
releaseGate: Contract or integration acceptance as applicable.

title: One-counter topology
text: **Priority:** MUST A one-counter deployment may run Store Node and PostgreSQL on the same Windows PC without changing domain behavior.
releaseGate: Contract or integration acceptance as applicable.

title: Multi-counter topology
text: **Priority:** MUST A multi-counter deployment shall support counters connecting over LAN to the designated Store Node/database host.
releaseGate: Contract or integration acceptance as applicable.

title: Signed/controlled update
text: **Priority:** MUST Production updates shall be controlled, versioned and recoverable; incompatible schema/application combinations shall be detected.
releaseGate: Contract or integration acceptance as applicable.

title: Hardware capability verification
text: **Priority:** MUST Required printer/scanner/scale/display capabilities shall be verified against supported target hardware before production reliance. ## 15. Release-gate note The following remain deployment or later-phase decisions rather than invented numeric requirements: - exact production RPO/RTO; - exact backup/log/audit retention periods; - exact supported peripheral models/interfaces; - remote-support provider; - integrated payment provider; - Phase-3 synchronization freshness/service-level targets; - current Malaysia/India legal thresholds, rates and deadlines. They must be approved in the relevant deployment/compliance specification before becoming production release gates.
releaseGate: Backup/restore-test operational acceptance.

title: Multiple languages
text: **Priority:** MUST MiniMart shall support multiple UI languages without separate application forks.
releaseGate: Contract or integration acceptance as applicable.

title: Locale presentation
text: **Priority:** MUST Currency, date, time, number and address presentation shall be configurable by store/country context.
releaseGate: Contract or integration acceptance as applicable.

title: Receipt scripts
text: **Priority:** MUST Receipt rendering shall support required customer-facing scripts subject to verified printer capability.
releaseGate: Contract or integration acceptance as applicable.

title: Country-pack isolation
text: **Priority:** MUST Country-specific tax, rounding, document and compliance behavior shall reside behind country-pack boundaries rather than fork the core product.
releaseGate: Contract or integration acceptance as applicable.

title: Compliance verification gate
text: **Priority:** MUST A country rule shall not be represented as production-compliant solely from assumption; current legal/tax/e-invoice behavior requires dated authoritative verification. ## 12. Maintainability and architecture governance
releaseGate: Contract security tests, revocation/fail-closed tests.

title: Modular boundaries
text: **Priority:** MUST Business modules shall have explicit ownership and public interfaces.
releaseGate: Contract or integration acceptance as applicable.

title: No cross-module internal-table dependency
text: **Priority:** MUST One module shall not depend directly on another module's private/internal tables as its functional integration contract.
releaseGate: Contract or integration acceptance as applicable.

title: Modular monolith baseline
text: **Priority:** MUST The initial backend remains a modular monolith; microservices require an explicit later architectural decision.
releaseGate: Contract or integration acceptance as applicable.

title: ADR governance
text: **Priority:** MUST Material architecture changes require an ADR or equivalent approved decision rather than silent implementation-agent divergence.
releaseGate: Contract or integration acceptance as applicable.

title: Migration review
text: **Priority:** MUST Production database migrations require explicit review and automated verification.
releaseGate: Contract or integration acceptance as applicable.

title: Country extension stability
text: **Priority:** MUST Adding a country pack shall not require duplicating core retail modules. ## 13. Testability and release quality
releaseGate: CI contract/replay/concurrency/offline suite.

title: Internet independence
text: **Priority:** MUST Loss of internet/cloud connectivity shall not block defined local store checkout while Store Node and local PostgreSQL remain healthy.
releaseGate: Cloud-disconnected acceptance suite; no checkout dependency.

title: Local outcome authority
text: **Priority:** MUST Delayed cloud synchronization shall not change the locally confirmed outcome of a completed store transaction.
releaseGate: Contract security tests, revocation/fail-closed tests.

title: Store-service failure distinction
text: **Priority:** MUST The product shall distinguish cloud-offline operation from Store Node/database unavailability; the latter may safely block posting.
releaseGate: Cloud-disconnected acceptance suite; no checkout dependency.

title: Local diagnostics
text: **Priority:** MUST Store/L1 support shall be able to inspect essential Store Node, database, hardware, backup and synchronization health without internet access.
releaseGate: Backup/restore-test operational acceptance.

title: Offline authorization
text: **Priority:** MUST Permissions required for offline operations shall be enforceable locally without requiring a live cloud authorization round trip. ## 4. Data integrity and concurrency
releaseGate: Contract security tests, revocation/fail-closed tests.

title: Health indicators
text: **Priority:** MUST Health indicators shall distinguish common application, Store Node, database, cloud/sync and peripheral failure classes.
releaseGate: Cloud-disconnected acceptance suite; no checkout dependency.

title: Actionable diagnostics
text: **Priority:** MUST Operational failures shall produce actionable diagnostic information without exposing secrets.
releaseGate: Contract or integration acceptance as applicable.

title: Correlation
text: **Priority:** MUST Critical requests/transactions shall have correlation identifiers sufficient to trace activity across POS, Store Node and synchronization logs.
releaseGate: Contract or integration acceptance as applicable.

title: Time-limited support access
text: **Priority:** MUST Remote/elevated support access shall be identity-based, time-limited/revocable and audited.
releaseGate: Contract or integration acceptance as applicable.

title: No support superuser shortcut
text: **Priority:** MUST Support capability shall not depend on a permanent universal business-administrator credential.
releaseGate: Contract or integration acceptance as applicable.

title: Bounded logs
text: **Priority:** MUST Operational logs shall have configurable bounded retention and shall not grow without control.
releaseGate: Contract or integration acceptance as applicable.

title: Clock/timezone visibility
text: **Priority:** MUST Diagnostics shall expose relevant store timezone/business-date/time context needed to investigate ordering, day-close and synchronization issues. ## 10. Usability
releaseGate: Contract or integration acceptance as applicable.

title: Barcode scan responsiveness
text: **Priority:** MUST Under the defined Phase-1 benchmark, normal barcode scan-to-cart-line response should be under **100 ms** excluding hardware scan latency.
contractFlow: API-CAT-007 GET /api/v1/catalog/barcodes/{barcode}:resolve → BarcodeResolution; contract test measures Store Node resolve path and UI scan-to-cart budget.
releaseGate: Barcode resolve/add-line benchmark; <100 ms under frozen benchmark conditions.

title: Product search
text: **Priority:** MUST Typical local product search should be under **50 ms** at approximately 50,000 active items under the defined benchmark.
releaseGate: Catalog search benchmark around 50k items; <50 ms under frozen benchmark conditions.

title: Checkout completion
text: **Priority:** MUST After all required local payment conditions are satisfied, local sale posting to receipt-ready state should normally complete within **1.5 seconds**, excluding external provider latency and physical printer throughput.
releaseGate: Local payment-confirmed to receipt-ready benchmark; normally <1.5 s excluding provider/printer.

title: Performance isolation
text: **Priority:** MUST Cloud synchronization, reporting, export, backup and diagnostic work shall not materially block foreground checkout under normal operating load.
releaseGate: Cloud-disconnected acceptance suite; no checkout dependency.

title: Multi-counter benchmark
text: **Priority:** MUST Release qualification for multi-counter deployment shall include representative concurrent sale, stock and held-sale workloads. ## 2. Reliability and durability
releaseGate: Contract or integration acceptance as applicable.

title: Data minimization
text: **Priority:** MUST Collect only customer/person data required for defined business, support or compliance purposes.
releaseGate: Contract or integration acceptance as applicable.

title: Role-based visibility
text: **Priority:** MUST PII and sensitive financial data shall be visible only to roles/functions that require it.
releaseGate: Contract or integration acceptance as applicable.

title: Diagnostic minimization
text: **Priority:** MUST Support bundles shall minimize PII/business-data exposure and redact secrets by default.
releaseGate: Contract or integration acceptance as applicable.

title: Export control
text: **Priority:** MUST Bulk customer/financial exports require explicit authorization and audit where specified.
releaseGate: Contract security tests, revocation/fail-closed tests.

title: Retention policy boundary
text: **Priority:** MUST Retention/anonymization/deletion behavior shall follow approved deployment/country policy and shall not destroy records required to preserve financial/audit history. ## 8. Backup, recovery and continuity
releaseGate: Backup/restore-test operational acceptance.

title: Posted transaction durability
text: **Priority:** MUST A locally confirmed posted business transaction shall survive application/service restart.
releaseGate: Contract or integration acceptance as applicable.

title: No silent loss
text: **Priority:** MUST Committed business transactions, Payment Commitments, Refund Obligations and other recoverable monetary states shall not be silently lost after restart.
releaseGate: Contract or integration acceptance as applicable.

title: Crash/power-loss qualification
text: **Priority:** MUST Critical posting workflows shall be tested for process crash, forced termination and representative power-loss/restart recovery.
releaseGate: CI contract/replay/concurrency/offline suite.

title: Idempotent retry
text: **Priority:** MUST Retry shall not create duplicate sale, stock, tender, payment, refund, purchase, accounting-lite or synchronization effects.
releaseGate: Contract or integration acceptance as applicable.

title: Explicit uncertain state
text: **Priority:** MUST When an external monetary outcome cannot be determined safely, MiniMart shall preserve an explicit uncertain/reconciliation state rather than guess success or failure.
releaseGate: Contract or integration acceptance as applicable.

title: Recovery without historical rewrite
text: **Priority:** MUST Recovery shall complete, reverse or reconcile an interrupted workflow without destructively rewriting already posted history.
releaseGate: Contract or integration acceptance as applicable.

title: Hardware failure isolation
text: **Priority:** MUST Peripheral failure after business posting shall not invalidate or duplicate the posted business transaction. ## 3. Offline and degraded operation
releaseGate: Cloud-disconnected acceptance suite; no checkout dependency.

title: Phase-1 catalog
text: **Priority:** MUST The Phase-1 design shall support at least 30,000--50,000+ active items without unacceptable checkout degradation.
releaseGate: Contract or integration acceptance as applicable.

title: Growth headroom
text: **Priority:** SHOULD The design should not prevent materially larger catalogs without replacing core domain concepts.
releaseGate: Contract or integration acceptance as applicable.

title: Counter growth
text: **Priority:** MUST MiniMart shall progress from one counter to multiple counters without replacing the application or cloning company-wide masters.
releaseGate: Contract or integration acceptance as applicable.

title: Store growth
text: **Priority:** MUST Core identity and ownership shall support later multi-store operation without redefining Item, Supplier or Customer identity.
releaseGate: Contract or integration acceptance as applicable.

title: Tenant readiness
text: **Priority:** MUST Cloud-facing records and contracts shall not prevent later shared multi-tenancy even when early customers use dedicated deployment. ## 6. Security
releaseGate: Contract security tests, revocation/fail-closed tests.

title: Authorization
text: **Priority:** MUST Sensitive operations require explicit authorization and, where specified, manager approval.
releaseGate: Contract security tests, revocation/fail-closed tests.

title: Credential protection
text: **Priority:** MUST Passwords, tokens, encryption keys and provider secrets shall not be stored in source code or ordinary plaintext configuration.
releaseGate: Contract or integration acceptance as applicable.

title: Password/PIN protection
text: **Priority:** MUST Password-equivalent secrets shall use approved modern password hashing and secure secret-storage mechanisms appropriate to their type.
releaseGate: Contract or integration acceptance as applicable.

title: No universal hidden credential
text: **Priority:** MUST MiniMart shall not use an undocumented universal master password or equivalent support bypass.
releaseGate: Contract or integration acceptance as applicable.

title: Audit of sensitive actions
text: **Priority:** MUST Manager overrides, permission changes, support elevation, sensitive exports and financial corrections shall be auditable.
releaseGate: Contract or integration acceptance as applicable.

title: Transport security
text: **Priority:** MUST Network communication carrying authentication, business or personal data shall use authenticated encrypted transport appropriate to the deployment.
releaseGate: Contract security tests, revocation/fail-closed tests.

title: Device enrollment
text: **Priority:** MUST Store/counter/cloud trust shall use explicit device/installation enrollment rather than implicit trust by network location alone.
releaseGate: Cloud-disconnected acceptance suite; no checkout dependency.

title: Payment-data minimization
text: **Priority:** MUST MiniMart shall avoid storing PAN or unnecessary payment-card credentials and shall retain only references/status data required by the approved integration.
releaseGate: Contract or integration acceptance as applicable.

title: Signed release artifacts
text: **Priority:** MUST Production installers/updates shall support authenticity/integrity verification through approved signing/release controls. ## 7. Privacy
releaseGate: Contract security tests, revocation/fail-closed tests.

title: Protected domain tests
text: **Priority:** MUST Critical money, inventory, posting, reversal, credit, accounting-lite and synchronization rules shall have automated tests.
releaseGate: CI contract/replay/concurrency/offline suite.

title: AI test guardrail
text: **Priority:** MUST AI coding agents shall not delete, weaken or bypass tests merely to make a change pass.
releaseGate: CI contract/replay/concurrency/offline suite.

title: Failure-mode acceptance
text: **Priority:** MUST Crash, retry, concurrency, offline, hardware-failure and uncertain external-payment/refund scenarios shall be included in acceptance testing.
releaseGate: Cloud-disconnected acceptance suite; no checkout dependency.

title: Contract tests
text: **Priority:** MUST Public module/API/synchronization contracts shall have automated compatibility/contract tests where appropriate.
releaseGate: CI contract/replay/concurrency/offline suite.

title: Country-pack regression
text: **Priority:** MUST Country-pack changes shall run common-core and relevant country regression tests and shall not alter posted historical outcomes.
releaseGate: CI contract/replay/concurrency/offline suite.

title: Restore drill evidence
text: **Priority:** MUST Release/operations evidence shall include successful restore-drill results according to the approved schedule. ## 14. Deployment and compatibility
releaseGate: Backup/restore-test operational acceptance.

title: High-frequency POS input
text: **Priority:** MUST High-frequency POS workflows shall be usable primarily with barcode scanner and keyboard, with mouse/touch as appropriate.
releaseGate: Contract or integration acceptance as applicable.

title: Offline visibility
text: **Priority:** MUST Cloud-offline status shall be visible without unnecessarily interrupting local checkout.
releaseGate: Cloud-disconnected acceptance suite; no checkout dependency.

title: Error classification
text: **Priority:** MUST User messages shall distinguish correctable validation errors, permission/approval requirements, hardware failures, uncertain payment/refund states and technical recovery conditions.
releaseGate: Contract or integration acceptance as applicable.

title: No duplicate-action encouragement
text: **Priority:** MUST During uncertain posting/payment/refund states, the UI shall not encourage users to repeat an action that may duplicate money or stock effects.
releaseGate: Contract or integration acceptance as applicable.

title: Recovery guidance
text: **Priority:** MUST Interrupted monetary workflows shall present explicit recovery/reconciliation guidance appropriate to user permission. ## 11. Localization and country packs
releaseGate: Contract or integration acceptance as applicable.
